title: fix(spec): the two-master controlled_by_parent refusal names its release
body:
Fixes #23387

Clause-②: no

The two-required-masters refusal of a `controlled_by_parent` object (`controlledByParentMasterRefusal`, `several-required-masters`) now reads "ADR-0055 §1: since @objectstack/spec 18, a controlled-by-parent object derives its master from exactly one required `master_detail` field, ...", the wording its no-master sibling already carries. `@objectstack/spec` 17.7.0 accepts both shapes, so both refusals now date themselves for 17 to 18 upgraders.

## What changed
- `packages/spec/src/data/controlled-by-parent-master.ts`: message text of the two-master branch only. Refused shapes, issue paths and the prescribed fix are unchanged.
- `packages/spec/src/data/object.test.ts`: the existing both-branches test now asserts that the two-master and the no-master message each contain "since @objectstack/spec 18, a controlled-by-parent object derives" (the pin that both branches carry it).
- `.changeset/23387-two-master-names-release.md`: `patch` for `@objectstack/spec` (text only, no accept-set change).

## Pin sweep
Grepped the repo for the message text (`does not say which master`, `a controlled-by-parent object derives`, `several-required-masters`, `controlledByParentMasterRefusal`): the only other asserters are `object.test.ts` prefix matchers that stop at `ADR-0055 §1:` (still green); `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts` carries its own prose, not this message. No consumer pin asserts the old text, and the plugin-security test named as a lead does not assert it. File surface matched the claim.

## Verification
- `@objectstack/spec`: `vitest run src/data src/conversions` 140 files / 4568 tests pass; `test:repo` 59 files / 1011 tests pass; `typecheck` green.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: all 85 derived families run (the build-dependent ones exited 3 before `@objectstack/spec` was built and 0 or green after), reconciled with `--ran`: 85 derived, 85 run, 0 UNRUN.
- Semantic entries named in the card's corrected scope are untouched.

Dedupe/ruling: no maintainer ruling; triage `6161187727` forbids any change to which shapes are refused.
